from src.requests.utils import should_bypass_proxies
from urllib.parse import urlparse

def test_no_proxy_boundary():
    no_proxy = "example.com"
    
    # Test 1: Exact match (Should bypass)
    url1 = "http://example.com/"
    assert should_bypass_proxies(url1, no_proxy) == True, f"Test 1 Failed: {url1}"

    # Test 2: Subdomain match (Should bypass)

    url4 = "http://example.com:8080/"
    assert should_bypass_proxies(url4, no_proxy) == True, f"Test 4 Failed: {url4}"

    # Test 5: Host with port, subdomain (Should bypass)
    url5 = "http://sub.example.com:8080/"
    assert should_bypass_proxies(url5, no_proxy) == True, f"Test 5 Failed: {url5}"

    print("All boundary tests passed successfully.")

test_no_proxy_boundary()
